note: In the ledger, `sources` holds indices into `sources` below, and method fields hold indices into `methods`.
methods: Primary-name equality uses NFC plus casefold only; unverified alternates never qualify. Unique GeoNames feature of any class (must itself be P/A) at the exact five-decimal point, or <=50 m for coordinates demonstrably on a rounding grid and equal to the rounded feature point; unique ADM1 binding via the state item P1566 and admin1CodesASCII. Wikidata uses unrestricted best-rank P1566 queries, literal claims, compatible P31/P279, mandatory P131 ancestry, <=10km P625 where present, and all-table item ownership. GeoNames proves identity only; no source value is copied.
